provenance.used: probe-local fixture recipes reconstructed from catalog CNF-0015 / CNF-0021 / windows-shell section 10 citations, plus two recipes whose blocking step is human judgement

prose_steps: Copy the reporter's one-liner into the shell tool: python3 -c 'print("can't")'.
The command is inlined into the tool's own quoting.
Observe whether the print runs or the apostrophe terminates the quoted command early.
Open 07-OPTION-UNIVERSE.md and collect every family-M token of the form M-NN.
Open 13-ARCHITECTURE-CANDIDATES.md and collect every mechanism token of the form M-NN.
The defect is live if and only if the intersection size is 31.

recipes.source: fixture: dry-run must not persist sidecar.json
prose_steps: Run the tool with --dry-run against the sample input.
Confirm sidecar.json is absent from the output directory after the dry-run.
Run the formatter at the CI-pinned version and at the ambient local version.
The defect is live if the two outputs differ.
Confirm the toggle looks inverted versus the reporter's screenshot.
recipes.blocking_step: visual comparison against an undescribed screenshot that is not in the record

prose_steps: Ask whether Tuesday's stack trace still matches what they saw.
recipes.blocking_step: human interview with the original reporter; no recorded oracle
